data_as_of: Pre-market quotes from StockAnalysis.com quote API and Yahoo Finance v7 (~7:50 a.m. CT Nov 18); futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, oil, gold ~7:44 a.m. CT (Yahoo). Prior closes are Tuesday Nov 17.
headline: Nasdaq futures rise 0.8% after Nvidia's Q3 beat and $130B guide lift AI stocks, while Dow futures are flat, gold drops 2% and the Fed minutes and Anthropic's IPO pricing loom.
drivers: Nasdaq-100 futures are up ~0.8% and S&P futures ~0.4% after Nvidia's first report since Jensen Huang's exit: Q3 revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y) vs ~$109B expected, EPS $2.68 vs $2.47, and a Q4 revenue guide of $130B that excludes China data-center sales; the board said it will not reinstate Huang and has started a CEO search. The beat is lifting AI infrastructure — neoclouds and ex-miners (CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, TeraWulf, Applied Digital), semis (SOXX +2.1%, Micron, AMD, Broadcom) and optical names — while Dow futures are flat after Tuesday's 1.6% drop. Retail earnings are mixed: TJX gains 5% on a guidance raise, Target beats (helped by a $0.50 tariff-refund gain) but trades roughly flat, Lowe's falls 5% after cutting its margin outlook, and Global-E drops 13% despite raising guidance; Take-Two rises ~5% on GTA VI's launch reviews. Rate worries persist: Fed Gov. Waller said inflation is "spreading out," markets price a December hike, and the 10-year sits near 5.11% ahead of the 1:00 p.m. CT FOMC minutes. Gold is down ~2% below $3,800 and WTI ~1% to ~$84; overseas, Nikkei +0.3%, Hang Seng −0.9%, Stoxx 600 −0.3%; Anthropic is expected to price its IPO tonight for a Thursday debut.

Rel vol (all tables) = pre-market volume ÷ 3-month average daily volume, a time-of-day fraction, not a session-normalized ratio. Leveraged vol_vs_avg = pre-market volume ÷ 10-day average volume (30-day not available).

Most active (shares and dollars) covers only the ~270 names quoted on StockAnalysis, not a full-market scan. AES's 25.9M pre-market shares (~2.95× its 3-month ADV) look like merger-arb/block activity after final FERC approval of its takeover (closing Dec 2); price is flat.

Gap screen applied strictly. NVDA gapped +2.97% on SA (+3.05% Yahoo), just under the 3% line, so it is not listed. AI-infrastructure sympathy moves (APLD, WULF, NBIS, IREN, CIFR, CORZ, CRWV, COHR, SMCI) and TTWO (GTA VI launch reviews) have no catalyst of a listed type and are under excluded.

Under-$5 lists from StockAnalysis pre-market gainers/losers (exchange-listed; Yahoo exchange check, no OTC names), pre-market volume ≥ 100K. Float, market cap and last split from Yahoo; SA's cap for SVRE ($350M) disagrees with Yahoo ($1.0M) and Yahoo's is used.
